newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Second bomb explodes in Bosnian Serb territory.
newsitem.headline: Second bomb explodes in Bosnian Serb territory.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside the apartment of an OSCE observer early on Tuesday morning in Bosnian Serb-controlled territory, the second night in a row that the organisation had apparently been targetted, officials said.

The blast caused no injuries but shattered windows of the apartment building in the northwestern town of Banja Luka, the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) mission reported in Sarajevo
Hostility is running high in Bosnia's Serb republic towards international monitors in Serb territory after a NATO raid last week on two Serbs indicted for war crimes.
British soldiers arrested one suspect and shot dead another who opened fire while resisting arrest.
The overnight bombing in Banja Luka raised concern over a possible nationalist backlash against international staff working in Serb territory.
On Sunday night, a bomb destroyed an OSCE pickup truck outside offices belonging to the OSCE and the United Nations mission in the eastern town of Zvornik. No one was injured in that explosion.
